text_en: You smell like you've been scorched. Where have you been?
You know how much I like it when you come by here from time to time to tell me about your travels, but could  you perhaps come back when you've had a good, long shower?
It's alright, my little friend. Don't take it the wrong way... I'm just ladding.
If you have valuable information, I recommend you share it with General Brigard.
